project.name: Common (aggregator)
project.description:
Aggregator for the shared modules every bounded context may depend on: common-domain (the entities ring — ADR-0019) and common-application (the shared presentation ring — ADR-0030). Build both with mvn -f common/pom.xml verify.
`common` is deliberately NOT named `common-service`: unlike identity, sabha, attendance and analytics it is not a bounded context, and ADR-0019 gives it no ring of its own — it depends on nothing else in the project.
Note the one naming collision, accepted in ADR-0031: `common-domain` here is a LEAF module (the entities ring), whereas a context's -domain module is an aggregator over a `-domain-core` / `-application-service` pair. There is no `common-domain-core`; `common-domain` is the whole thing.
